about.what: Pre-match win, draw and loss probabilities for the 104 matches of the 2026 World Cup, from a model of Elo ratings. A model's forecast, not a betting line or an official rating.
about.model: Symmetric ordered logit on the Elo gap (per 100 points) and the home flag (scripts/analysis/ordered_logit.py)
about.results: After extra time; a shootout counts as a draw.
about.ratings: Each match uses both teams' Elo ratings just before it, so the ratings take in the earlier 2026 results.
about.scores: Mean per match, lower is better except accuracy. Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals over the 104 matches. *_minus_elo_model is the paired gap to the Elo model: above zero means worse than the model.
